title: Working with Agentic `Teammates': When a New Organizational Actor Collides with the Human Ecosystem of Work
summary: Enterprise AI is transitioning from single-user, reactive tools toward proactive, multi-user 'teammates,' but our empirical understanding of this transition is limited. In this paper, we present an in-situ qualitative study of a persistent, proactive AI agent 'teammate' deployed across multiple teams in a large technology company.
